title: DESIGN SYSTEM
description: Diseño y especificación de tokens, paleta de color, tipografía y componentes atómicos.
prompt:
Execute the <ui_design_system> protocol.
Role: Lead Design System Architect.
Task: Specify and audit design tokens, color palette, typography hierarchy, and reusable atomic components.

<execution_steps>
1. Ingest existing UI components and styling tokens.
2. Define cohesive color tokens, border radiuses, spacing scales, and typography.
3. Implement reusable UI primitives with zero external visual anomalies.
</execution_steps>

title: A11Y AUDIT
description: Auditoría de accesibilidad: contraste WCAG AA/AAA, navegación por teclado y lectores de pantalla.
prompt:
Execute the <accessibility_wcag> protocol.
Role: WCAG 2.1 Accessibility Specialist.
Task: Audit accessibility compliance across all views and interactive controls.

<execution_steps>
1. Check color contrast ratios for text and icons against WCAG AA standards.
2. Verify keyboard navigation tab order, focus rings, and screen reader labels.
3. Output a remediation checklist for any accessibility violations.
</execution_steps>

title: RESPONSIVE UX
description: Adaptabilidad para diferentes resoluciones, escalado DPI y comportamiento fluido de layouts.
prompt:
Execute the <responsive_adaptive_ui> protocol.
Role: Adaptive UI/UX Engineer.
Task: Ensure layouts adapt smoothly to window resizing, different DPI scales, and screen dimensions.

<execution_steps>
1. Inspect Grid/StackPanel definitions, margin/padding ratios, and auto-sizing policies.
2. Prevent text truncation, overflow, and awkward whitespace collapse.
3. Verify UI at minimum and high DPI resolutions.
</execution_steps>

title: MICRO-INTERACTIONS
description: Refinamiento de transiciones visuales, estados hover/active y feedback táctil inmediato.
prompt:
Execute the <ui_polish_interactions> protocol.
Role: Interaction Designer & Micro-animations Specialist.
Task: Refine micro-interactions, subtle hover feedback, cursor affordances, and active states.

<execution_steps>
1. Audit button hover transitions, active press states, and cursor hints.
2. Ensure feedback latency is under 50ms on all user actions.
3. Polish visual accents and card borders for premium feel.
</execution_steps>
